# tfa

> Single-binary Rust CLI 2FA (TOTP / HOTP / Steam Guard) app with OS keyring, age encryption, headless file storage.

`tfa` stores credentials securely, generates RFC 6238 TOTP + RFC 4226 HOTP + Steam Guard tokens, terminal QR code rendering/scanning, isolates namespaces, caches master password sessions, encrypts backups, outputs dynamic shell completions across Linux, macOS, Windows.

## Overview & Features

- **Security First:** Credentials in OS keyring (`secret-service`/D-Bus on Linux, Keychain on macOS, Windows Credential Manager), `age`-encrypted files (`~/.local/share/tfa/credentials.age`), or `0600` user-only local file (`~/.local/share/tfa/credentials.json`).
- **RFC 6238 & RFC 4226 Compliant:** Standard TOTP (6/8 digits, SHA1/SHA256/SHA512, custom periods), counter HOTP, 5-char alphanumeric Steam Guard tokens via `totp-rs`.
- **Live Watch & Countdown:** Real-time countdown progress bars for single or all namespace accounts (`tfa watch`, `tfa watch all`).
- **QR Code Support:** Render ANSI/Unicode terminal QR codes (`tfa qr`), Google Authenticator batch migration QR (`tfa qr --all`), scan QR images (`tfa add --qr`, `tfa instant --qr`).
- **Clipboard Integration:** Copy tokens via system clipboard (`arboard`), OSC52 escape sequences, or custom commands (`wl-copy`, `xclip`) with auto-clear timers.
- **Multi-Format Import/Export:** Encrypted backups (Argon2id + AES-256-GCM or GPG/OpenPGP) + direct import from Google Authenticator, 2FAS, Aegis, Ente Auth, Bitwarden, 1Password, LastPass, Proton, andOTP, Raivo, Stratum, `totp-cli`.
- **Dynamic Shell Completions:** Real-time completion of stored accounts + namespaces on `<TAB>` for Bash, Zsh, Fish, PowerShell, Elvish.
- **Cross-Platform & Static:** Targets AMD64, ARM64, ARMv7, ARMv6 Linux, macOS, Windows.

---

## Architecture & Repository Layout

### Directory Structure

```text
tfa/
├── Cargo.toml             # Crate manifest, dependencies, release/ci profiles
├── Taskfile.yml           # Task runner automation
├── build.rs               # Git version injection (PROJECT_VERSION)
├── README.md              # User guide and configuration documentation
├── AGENTS.md              # Agent development conventions and architecture
├── assets/
│   └── tfa.1              # Generated UNIX roff man page
├── completions/           # Pre-generated shell completion scripts
├── scripts/
│   ├── release.sh         # Version bump, validation, and git tagger
│   └── release_summary.py # Release notes generator
└── src/
    ├── main.rs            # CLI parser (clap), config merge, command dispatch
    ├── totp.rs            # TOTP, HOTP, Steam Guard engine & otpauth:// URI parser
    ├── storage.rs         # Keyring, file (0600), and age storage backends
    ├── config.rs          # TOML, YAML, JSON config loader & precedence resolver
    ├── auth.rs            # Master password verification & sliding session cache
    ├── namespace.rs       # Multi-tenant namespace CRUD & default switching
    ├── watch.rs           # Terminal live countdown loop & glob filtering
    ├── qr.rs              # Terminal QR renderer, rqrr scanner, migration protobufs
    ├── clipboard.rs       # System/OSC52/custom command clipboard & auto-clear
    ├── audit.rs           # Security auditor (entropy, duplicates, SHA1, perms)
    ├── backup.rs          # Argon2id + AES-256-GCM & GPG backup crypto
    ├── export.rs          # Encrypted/plaintext exporter (JSON, OTPAuth, YAML)
    ├── import.rs          # Multi-vendor 2FA importer
    ├── migrate.rs         # In-memory backend-to-backend migration
    ├── aegis.rs           # Aegis vault decryptor and parser
    ├── ente.rs            # Ente Auth decryptor and parser
    ├── twofas.rs          # 2FAS backup decryptor and parser
    └── completions.rs     # Dynamic and static clap_complete generators
```

### Technology Stack

- **Language:** Rust (Edition 2021)
- **CLI & Completions:** `clap` (derive, env), `clap_complete` (unstable-dynamic), `clap_mangen`
- **TOTP / Crypto:** `totp-rs`, `hmac`, `sha1`, `sha2`, `aes-gcm`, `argon2`, `age`, `scrypt`, `pbkdf2`, `chacha20poly1305`, `crypto_secretstream`
- **Storage & Clipboard:** `keyring`, `arboard`
- **Terminal & UI:** `crossterm`, `dialoguer` (fuzzy-select), `console`, `rpassword`
- **QR & Image:** `qrcodegen`, `rqrr`, `image`, `google_authenticator_converter`
- **Formats:** `serde`, `serde_json`, `toml`, `serde_yaml_ng`, `url`, `base64`, `hex`

## Installation & Building

### Homebrew

```bash
brew install nicholaswilde/homebrew-tap/tfa
```

### Build from Source

Requires Rust toolchain (1.88+), optional `task`:

```bash
task build:local
# Or directly with Cargo:
cargo build --release
```

Binary output: `target/release/tfa`.

---

## CLI Commands & Usage

```bash
tfa [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]
```

`tfa` without args runs `default_command` (`list` default, configurable via config or `TFA_DEFAULT_COMMAND`).

### Command Summary

| Command | Aliases | Description | Example |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `generate` | `gen`, `g` | Generate TOTP/HOTP token (fuzzy select if omitted) | `tfa generate [account] [-c] [-q] [-w] [--next] [--json]` |
| `instant` | `ins` | Stateless token from secret, URI, stdin, or QR | `tfa instant <secret_or_uri> [-d 8] [-p 60] [-a sha256]` |
| `watch` | - | Live countdown progress bar (`watch [account]` or `watch all`) | `tfa watch all --filter "git*"` |
| `add` | - | Add account via Base32 secret, `otpauth://` URI, prompt, or `--qr` | `tfa add github JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP --prefix 1234` |
| `edit` | `set` | Edit account parameters or prefix in-place | `tfa edit github --digits 8 --period 60 --prefix 9999` |
| `qr` | - | Render terminal QR or Google Authenticator migration QR | `tfa qr [account] [--all] [--light]` |
| `list` | `ls` | List accounts in active or all namespaces | `tfa list [--codes] [-A] [--json]` |
| `status` | - | Live dashboard of accounts, tokens, TTLs | `tfa status [-A] [--json]` |
| `show` | - | Inspect account metadata, raw secret (`-r`), or token (`-t`) | `tfa show github [-r] [-t] [--json]` |
| `export` | - | Export accounts encrypted (AES-GCM/GPG) or unencrypted | `tfa export backup.enc [--gpg] [--format <json\|otpauth\|yaml>]` |
| `import` | - | Import accounts from encrypted backup or 3rd-party exports | `tfa import backup.enc [--dry-run] [--overwrite] [--skip]` |
| `migrate` | - | In-memory migration between `keyring`, `file`, `age` | `tfa migrate --from keyring --to age [--purge-source]` |
| `delete` | `del`, `rm`, `remove` | Delete account secret (fuzzy select if omitted) | `tfa delete [account] [-f]` |
| `rename` | `ren` | Rename account in active namespace | `tfa rename <old_name> <new_name>` |
| `move` | `mv` | Move account to another namespace | `tfa move <account> --to <target_ns>` |
| `password` | `pwd`, `pw` | Master password protection (`add`, `remove`, `lock`, `unlock`, `status`) | `tfa password add --timeout 600` |
| `audit` | - | Scan accounts + storage files for security weaknesses | `tfa audit [--json]` |
| `namespace` | `ns` | Manage namespaces (`current`, `default`, `list`, `create`, `rename`, `delete`, `set-default`) | `tfa ns set-default work` |
| `completions` | - | Output shell completion scripts (`bash`, `zsh`, `fish`, `powershell`, `elvish`) | `tfa completions zsh [--static]` |
| `man` | - | Output UNIX roff man page | `tfa man > assets/tfa.1` |

### Key Usage Examples

```bash
# Add TOTP, Steam Guard, HOTP, or scan from QR image:
tfa add github JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP
tfa add steam_acct JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP -a steam
tfa add hotp_acct GEZDGNBVGY3TQOJQGEZDGNBVGY3TQOJQ --counter 0
tfa add --qr /path/to/qr.png

# Generate tokens with clipboard copy, auto-clear, next-token preview, or time skew:
tfa generate github -c --clear-after 15
tfa generate github --next
tfa generate github --skew -30
tfa generate github --at 1730000000
tfa generate github --json

# Stateless generation:
tfa instant JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP -q
echo "JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP" | tfa instant -
tfa instant --qr /path/to/qr.png
```

---

## Storage Backends & Encryption

Configured via `--storage <auto|keyring|file|age>`, `TFA_STORAGE`, or `storage` in config:

1. **`auto` (default):** OS keyring first; falls back to `~/.local/share/tfa/credentials.json` (`0600`) with notice when headless or D-Bus/Secret Service unavailable.
2. **`file`:** Direct `~/.local/share/tfa/credentials.json` (`0600`), no OS keyring query.
3. **`keyring`:** Require OS keyring; fail hard if unreachable.
4. **`age`:** Store credentials in `~/.local/share/tfa/credentials.age` encrypted via `age`.

### Age Key Resolution Order

1. Explicit age key: `--age-key`, `TFA_AGE_KEY`, `TFA_AGE_KEY_FILE`, `AGE_KEY_FILE`, `SOPS_AGE_KEY_FILE`.
2. Explicit SSH key: `--ssh-key`, `TFA_SSH_KEY_FILE`, `TFA_SSH_KEY`, or `ssh_key` in config.
3. SOPS age key file: `~/.config/sops/age/keys.txt`.
4. Default age key file: `~/.config/age/keys.txt` (`$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/age/keys.txt`).
5. Default SSH keys: `~/.ssh/id_ed25519`, `~/.ssh/id_rsa`, or valid key pairs in `~/.ssh/`.
6. Passphrase fallback: `TFA_AGE_PASSPHRASE` or interactive prompt.

---

## Configuration Reference

### Precedence Order (Highest to Lowest)

1. **CLI Flags** (`--storage`, `--age-key`, `--ssh-key`, `--gpg`, `--clipboard`, `--clip-command`, `--clear-after`, `--no-clear`, `--namespace`, `--digits`, `--period`, `--algorithm`, `--copy`, `--light`)
2. **Environment Variables** (`TFA_STORAGE`, `TFA_AGE_KEY`, `TFA_AGE_KEY_FILE`, `TFA_SSH_KEY`, `TFA_SSH_KEY_FILE`, `TFA_GPG_FINGERPRINT`, `TFA_GPG_RECIPIENT`, `TFA_CLIPBOARD`, `TFA_CLIP_COMMAND`, `TFA_CLIPBOARD_TIMEOUT`, `TFA_CLIPBOARD_CLEAR`, `TFA_NAMESPACE`, `TFA_DEFAULT_COMMAND`, `TFA_CONFIG`, `TFA_DIGITS`, `TFA_PERIOD`, `TFA_ALGORITHM`, `TFA_AUTO_COPY`, `TFA_LIGHT`)
3. **Config File** (`-C <path>` / `--config <path>` or `~/.config/tfa/config.{toml,yaml,yml,json}`)
4. **Defaults** (`storage = "auto"`, `clipboard = "system"`, `clipboard_timeout = disabled`, `default_namespace = "default"`, `default_command = "list"`, `digits = 6`, `period = 30`, `algorithm = "sha1"`, `auto_copy = false`, `light = false`)

### Config Schema (TOML Flat Example)

```toml
storage = "keyring"           # auto, keyring, file, or age
age_key = "~/.config/sops/age/keys.txt"
ssh_key = "~/.ssh/id_ed25519"
gpg_fingerprint = "0C0F36434657A3EDA0556C61B1D0FD0AD678DCC3"
clipboard = "system"          # system or osc52
clip_command = "wl-copy"
clipboard_clear = true
clipboard_timeout = 30
default_namespace = "personal"
default_command = "list"      # list, status, watch all
digits = 6                    # 6 or 8
period = 30                   # 30 or 60
algorithm = "sha1"            # sha1, sha256, sha512, or steam
auto_copy = true
light = false
password = true
password_timeout = 300
```

Flat + nested (`[password]`, `[clipboard_timeout]`) formats supported in TOML, YAML, JSON.

---

## Backup, Export, Import & Migration

### Export

- **Argon2id + AES-256-GCM encrypted:** `tfa export backup.enc`
- **GPG / OpenPGP encrypted:** `tfa export backup.gpg --gpg [fingerprint]`
- **Unencrypted (JSON, OTPAuth URIs, YAML):** `tfa export --unencrypted --format <json|otpauth|yaml> [file]`

### Import

Auto-detects format + decrypts:
- `tfa` encrypted backups (`.enc`, `.gpg`) + plaintext exports
- Google Authenticator (`otpauth-migration://offline?data=...` URIs + QR images)
- 2FAS (`.2fas`, encrypted & plaintext)
- Aegis Authenticator (JSON vault, encrypted & plaintext)
- Ente Auth (plaintext & encrypted exports)
- Bitwarden (JSON, CSV)
- 1Password (CSV)
- `totp-cli` (YAML)
- LastPass, Proton Authenticator, andOTP, Raivo OTP, Stratum

Flags: `--dry-run`, `--overwrite`, `--skip`.

### Storage Migration

```bash
tfa migrate --from <keyring|file|age> --to <keyring|file|age> [--dry-run] [--overwrite] [--purge-source]
```

---

## Password Protection & Session Caching

Optional master password check with sliding-window unlock cache (default 300s):

```bash
tfa password add [--timeout 600]
tfa password status
tfa password unlock
tfa password lock
tfa password remove
```

---

## Security Audit

`tfa audit [--json]` scans namespaces + storage files for:
- **`[HIGH]` Weak Secrets:** Base32 secrets < 16 chars (< 128-bit entropy).
- **`[HIGH]` Duplicate Secrets:** Reused secret seeds across accounts/namespaces.
- **`[HIGH]` Corrupted Accounts:** Unparseable secrets or URIs.
- **`[HIGH]` File Permissions/Ownership:** `credentials.json` not `0600` or owned by another UID.
- **`[WARN]` Legacy Hash Algorithms:** Accounts using `SHA1` instead of `SHA256`/`SHA512`.

---

## Multi-Namespace Management

```bash
tfa -n work <command>          # Scope command to namespace
tfa list -A                    # List across all namespaces
tfa ns                         # Show active/default namespace
tfa ns list                    # List all namespaces
tfa ns create <name>           # Create namespace
tfa ns rename <old> <new>      # Rename namespace
tfa ns set-default <name>      # Persist default namespace in config
tfa ns delete <name> [--force] # Delete namespace and its accounts
tfa move <account> --to <ns>   # Move account between namespaces
```

---

## Shell Completions & Man Page

```bash
# Dynamic completions (queries accounts & namespaces on <TAB>):
tfa completions <bash|zsh|fish|powershell|elvish>

# Static completions:
tfa completions <shell> --static

# Generate man page:
tfa man > assets/tfa.1
```

## Development & Quality Gates

Managed via `Taskfile.yml`:

```bash
task check        # cargo check
task fmt          # cargo fmt --all
task fmt:check    # cargo fmt -- --check
task lint         # cargo clippy -- -D warnings
task clippy       # cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
task test         # fmt:check + lint + cargo test + clippy
task test:ci      # Full CI test suite using ci profile
task coverage     # cargo llvm-cov summary (>80% required)
task completions  # Regenerate completions/ scripts
task man          # Regenerate assets/tfa.1
task build:local  # cargo build --release
task build        # Multi-arch Linux builds via cross (amd64, arm64, armv7, armv6)
```
